---
title: "Crow Feather Shape Analyses"
author: "Justin Mann"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
data <- read.csv("feather_pca_test.csv", h=T)
```

```{r}
comp_data <- data[,1:5]

pca_result <- prcomp(comp_data, center = T, scale. = T)
summary(pca_result)
```

```{r}
pca_result$rotation
```
```{r}
biplot(pca_result)
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
pca_df <- data.frame(pca_result$x, FCode = as.factor(data$tail.code), Sex = data$sex)
ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Sex))+
  geom_point(size = 2)+
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.95)+
  theme_minimal()
```
